config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.anthup]
dialect = "anthropic"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
headers = { "X-Catalog-Token" = "cat-secret" }

[catalog.model_providers]
"other-known" = "anthup"
name: m4_catalog_unmapped_anthropic_404
